items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he took some of his pupils and he organized a banjo band, but he implemented it with the marimba -- he had a big marimba, so as a kid, I was 13 going on 14.

ctx.x: banjo -- he wrote a lot of banjo, he was in all those things in the twenties, he was a banjo virtuoso, and he was also a very strange person.

So we built a base banjo. In those days, they made them to your specifications. And he organized, he gave banjo lessons, among other things, locally, and he took some of his pupils and he organized a banjo band, but he implemented it with the marimba -- he had a big marimba, so as a kid, I was 13 going on 14.
Now what was this man's name again?
